text:
anya: Heads-up — nightly cron-eval failed on ci-nightly-2 around 00:03 UTC. Symptoms: GPU memory drift reported, then several eval shards timed out/OOMed. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1939998888 :eyes:
ben: copy. which evals are erroring? short list pls
anya: main failures: `eval/squad_perf` (timeout after 6m), `eval/throughput_bench` OOM on gpu0, and `rerank_x` metric jump (WER +3%). stack snippets in logs link.
mohit: tagging @elaine for bisect? could be model checkpoint drift or kernel update on the pool. :thinking_face:
elaine: I can take a quick look. any recent infra changes pushed to nightly pool?
anya: infra deploys: none in last 12h per deploybot, but kernel patches landed on pool node group `g4-nightly` yesterday. Also we rotated drivers for ci-nightly-2.
ben: ok first steps: 1) requeue job on different pool 2) rerun failing shards 3) if still failing, bisect model checkpoint vs runtime change.
anya: requeue done: `ci run --job=eval-nightly --pool=ci-nightly-3 --shards=4 --force-rerun` (ran at 00:08 UTC).
CI-bot: Rerun queued by @anya — job id 1939998897.
mohit: if the rerun passes on nighty-3 that points to pool drift. if it still fails, we bisect binary/driver changes.
elaine: I kicked off a scoped rerun for just `eval/squad_perf` and `eval/throughput_bench` on ci-nightly-3; also pulled the kernel logs for ci-nightly-2 nodes for comparison.
sre-bot: Alert: node ci-nightly-2-gpu-01 reported memory reclaim events at 23:57 UTC (see /var/log/syslog snippet).
anya: rerun results: most shards passed, but `eval/throughput_bench` still hit intermittent OOM on gpu1 (different machine). looks flaky not deterministic.
ben: weird — maybe workload variation + kernel change. can we force a lower batch size as a quick mitigation?
mohit: temp mitigation: set `BATCH_TOKENS=1024` for nightly evals and re-run. if that stabilizes, we'll open a change for the suite.
anya: done, rerun with smaller batch. pass on all shards except a single rerank_x metric blip (0.6% dev from baseline).
elaine: I'll start a bisect job across driver versions vs model checkpoints next window. assigning to myself, will update thread.
anya: created ticket: INTERNAL-4582 with logs and rerun ids. tagging infra to audit driver rollout on ci-nightly-2.
mohit: thanks team. summary: likely transient infra/driver issue; temporary config change applied. if @elaine's bisect finds a root cause we'll revert or pin. :thumbsup:
ben: follow-up: leaving `eval-nightly` paused on ci-nightly-2 pool until infra confirms healthy.
anya: marking this thread resolved for now, will re-open if bisect surfaces a reproducible regression.
